headline: Fanta's AI-made Halloween advert has drawn a wave of criticism online.

summary: Creative Bloq reports that Fanta's Halloween advert, made by the AI studio GRAiL as part of a 'Haunted Universe' of AI-made characters, has drawn mostly negative reaction, with many people vowing never to buy Fanta again. The brand plans to make the Halloween universe an annual occasion, and the writer saw the advert before a film at the cinema around 1 Oct 2026.
